  "title": "Investigate \"DIY\" Compliance/GDPR on canonical pages",
  "body": "**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**\r\nCurrently, we do not have a GDPR-compliant banner for consenting to accept cookies. We should evaluate the work required to copy this behaviour, without importing unnecessary javascript & CSS.\r\n\r\nHere \"DIY\" means \"not using Orbit\".\r\n\r\n**Describe the solution you'd like**\r\nCreate the front-end for the Cookie banner component.\r\nCreate a container for the GDPR-compliance logic for the banner. This should currently only contain canonical-specific logic. Later on, we will add the AMP logic to this same container.\r\n\r\nJS logic implementation: We should try and emulate orbits logic as much as possible, using the same cookies ETC. We should reuse orbits story definitions to ensure we are equally compliant.\r\nhttps://github.com/bbc/nav-orbit/blob/master/test/cucumber/features/stories/021-gdpr/banner-cookie-prompt.feature\r\n\r\n**Describe alternatives you've considered**\r\nA clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.\r\n\r\n**Testing notes**\r\nWe can add Cypress tests to check the logic of this banner.\r\n- Does the banner appear the first time the user hits the page?\r\n- Check banner behaviour around user acceptance/rejection of the cookie\r\n- Do the buttons work as expected?\r\n\r\nOther than Cypress, this will require testing across devices along with an accessibility run through to make sure that it's accessible for users using AT.\r\n\r\nDev insight: Locally, we should have unit tests that capture the visual representation for the cookie banner. Once the PR is merged in and deployed up to Test, we can observe by visiting `https://www.test.bbc.com/news/articles/c85pqyj5m2ko`.\r\n\r\n**Additional context**\r\nAdd any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.\r\n\r\n- [x] Initially labelled with [\"Refinement needed\"](https://github.com/bbc/simorgh/labels/Refinement%20Needed)",
  "state": "closed",
  "closed_at": "2019-02-25T12:05:56Z",
  "updated_at": "2019-02-26T12:01:57Z"
}
